methodology: Every app, protocol, wallet and exchange that swaps an asset on one chain for an asset on another, classified by category, custody model during the swap, user KYC, interface fee, routing, native Bitcoin and Solana support and chain coverage. Liveness checked by HTTP and, behind bot protection, in a real browser. Fees and coverage are filled in only from official pages and docs (verified=true, with source_url); null means not yet checked. Custody describes who holds the user's funds while the swap is in flight.

field_dictionary.name: App or protocol name
field_dictionary.category: native-dex = own validators and liquidity | intent-network = solvers/relayers fill orders | bridge = moves assets with own pools or messaging | aggregator = routes across other protocols | frontend = interface on THORChain/Maya/Chainflip | wallet = swap built into a wallet | instant-exchange = custodial no-account exchange | exchange-aggregator = compares instant exchanges
field_dictionary.custody: non-custodial = funds stay in contracts, vaults or the user's wallet throughout | custodial = an operator's wallet receives the funds first | hybrid = depends on the route chosen
field_dictionary.kyc: none | risk-based = no account, but flagged transactions can be held for KYC | required
field_dictionary.fee_pct: Interface or service fee the app adds, percent of the swap; null = not yet verified. Protocol, liquidity and network costs are separate
field_dictionary.routes_via: What the swap is executed through
field_dictionary.native_btc: Swaps native Bitcoin (not a wrapped token) in or out; null = not yet verified
field_dictionary.solana: Supports Solana; null = not yet verified
field_dictionary.chains: Approximate number of chains supported; null = not yet verified
field_dictionary.status_note: Why a row is inactive or unchecked, or what changed
field_dictionary.verified: true = fee and coverage confirmed on an official page
field_dictionary.source_url: Page the verified figures were read from
field_dictionary.checked: Date of the last liveness and verification pass
